description: The hard limits of every network: characters, post bytes, title length, number of images, video duration and file size. Check these before writing a post — the same text is fine on LinkedIn and rejected on X. Two of them are not interchangeable: Bluesky counts BOTH 300 characters and 3000 bytes, and an emoji is one character but several bytes.
name: get_social_limits
title: Get per-network limits
